title: When the Ledger Sings Again
author: Emrys Thornbury
blurb: Astrid Nystrom, a hotel concierge who notices everything, has quietly solved three deaths the police called accidents. Then the missing person's diary continues past the date she disappeared — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must close the one case everyone swore was closed for good, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
